content:
Dear Lean community members who have used or are using Coq,

The Coq team kindly requests your participation in the Coq community survey 2022. This survey will help us get an updated picture of the Coq community and inform our future decisions. As part of the survey, you will be able to record that you are a Lean user, and we plan to share aggregate survey data with the wider proof assistant community.

The deadline for submitting the survey is February 28, 2022 (AoE). Since the survey is quite long, please don't wait until the last minute to start answering. The survey is available in English and in Chinese. See our Discourse post for more information about the survey.

Regards,
The Coq team
